name: Vinh

queries.query: Vinh Nghe An cadastral map official parcel land registry GIS
queries.result: Search identified the official Nghệ An land-data procedure, the national VNSDI/DOSM geospatial portal, and a national VBDLIS land-information login endpoint; no public Vinh parcel service or bounded parcel response was established.

queries.query: Vinh Nghệ An bản đồ địa chính cổng thông tin chính thức thửa đất
queries.result: Search identified the official Nghệ An land-data supply procedure handled by the land-registration office/branch, commune authorities, and provincial agriculture/environment department; it did not expose an anonymous public parcel map/API for Vinh.

officialSources.observation: Official Nghệ An procedure for supplying land information/data. It names the provincial land-registration office, branches, commune authorities, and provincial agriculture/environment department as responsible bodies and identifies Vinh as the provincial service location; it is a procedure, not an open parcel geometry API.

Official national geospatial portal. The fetched public viewer loaded over HTTPS and its current JavaScript/configuration exposed base-map/administrative services, including NenBanDoDaTyLe_diagioidam and Bien_7zoom_Nen_911; no cadastral parcel layer or anonymous parcel query was verified.
Official-looking VBDLIS land-information endpoint returned a login/restricted-access page. No credentials or private fields were used.
Official Vinh city portal domain found in first-party search results; no public parcel viewer/API was exposed by the inspected result.

requests.outcome: Public portal fetched successfully (5791 bytes). Current JavaScript assets were inspected; only national/base-map service references were found, not a city parcel layer or safe parcel schema.
Returned a login/restricted-access page (1877 bytes). No login attempted.
Official procedure page fetched successfully (87442 bytes); it documents requesting land information through Nghệ An authorities but does not provide an anonymous parcel geometry response.

registryBasis: A local/provincial land-information custodian is evidenced by Nghệ An's official procedure, but no public city-bounded registry/map response or parcel geometry was verified. National portal and restricted VBDLIS evidence do not establish an open Vinh parcel source.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Nghệ An official land-information procedure and national VNSDI/DOSM/VBDLIS systems as described by their first-party pages.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No city-bounded Vinh parcel record, stable native parcel identity, schema, CRS, or geometry was retrieved.

remainingUncertainty: The existence, coverage, access policy, endpoint, schema, and CRS of any Vinh cadastral layer remain unverified. A zero exact-point result was not used as an absence claim; no exact-point parcel request was made because no public parcel endpoint was identified.
